Lake Mary beat Washington 5-0 in Friday's elimination to earn a rematch with North Carolina.

Today: Purple Bracket Championship — NC vs. Florida.

Anna-Lynn Clark is rested. Clark already struck out 13 Florida batters this week. #LLSWS2026

Grand Final: Sunday. #LLSWS2026 #Softball

stories.title: AUSL All-Star Cup Series 1 Is Live — Garcia, Ricketts, Corrick Lead the Draft

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
The 2026 AUSL All-Star Cup is not a preview anymore.

It started today in Rosemont, IL.

Series 1 captains: Rachel Garcia. Keilani Ricketts. Georgina Corrick.

45 players. No permanent teams. One individual champion. #AUSL

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
AUSL All-Star Cup format reminder:

Teams are fully redrafted before every series.
No team wins. No team loses.
Only individual points matter.

That means every at-bat in Rosemont today counts. #AUSL #Softball
